title: Story line map
description: story/<n>_lines.yaml, with <n> the script id in 3 digits (000 for MAPHEAD): for each line of the Lua module next to it (story/<n>.lua) that runs an instruction of the original script, the offset of that instruction in the script's listing (script/maphead.yaml, script/dg/<n>.yaml). dwx extract writes it with the module (formats/src/script/lua_emitter.cpp); error messages and parity traces read it, the game does not run it.
